heading: Constructed replies
text:
### Constructed replies [LTSL.7.3]

A stub's reply is one or more constructed facts ([LTSL.4.1]) — one for a single
reply, several for a batch. A reply to a call of a service declaring `response T`
is a fact of `T` ([LCRS.4.3.1]) or a `CallError`; the compiler must reject a
reply of any other schema (`DS_VALIDATE_TEST_STUB_REPLY_TYPE`).
